synthesis.summary_text: Customer dissatisfaction primarily stems from courier transit trauma rather than core product taste. Reviewers report crushed outer packaging and punctured moisture barriers causing staleness upon arrival.

evidence.text: This must have been sitting in a warehouse forever, because two of the boxes were almost inedible...
Amazon's packaging really bad... arrived torn all to pieces and product damaged...

recorded_runs.query: gluten free pizza crust texture complaints

synthesis.summary_text: Gluten-sensitive buyers praise taste authenticity when baked according to instructions, but express acute dissatisfaction when dough remains gummy, bakes overly dry, or fails to rise.

evidence.text: bunch of gluten-free flours... pizza crust... Disgusting pizza crust.
We have a gluten free house... Bob Red Mills pizza Crust. This just didn't taste like pizza...
